title: 雷克塞·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 低矮巨大身躯覆紫色甲壳，高大背鳍与长尾保留非人轮廓。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Rek’Sai has a low massive void-creature body, purple chitin armor, a prominent dorsal fin, broad forelimbs, smaller supporting limbs, and a long heavy tail. Preserve her nonhuman quadrupedal body plan and segmented plates, with a closed mouth and no exposed tissue or exaggerated teeth.
art_direction.scene: A gently elevated three-quarter arrangement, the signature motif nearest the viewer, modest accurate perspective and fresh reflected colors. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: purple, mauve, basalt gray, cyan rim; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
